day_shape: 46 items dominated by regime-channel coverage of Khamenei's week-long funeral (foreign delegations, granddaughter's coffin), IDF strikes on ~10 Hezbollah sites in southern Lebanon after a reservist was severely wounded, and reported Iran-Japan oil talks under a US sanctions waiver.

threads.label: Khamenei week-long funeral coverage
threads.summary: Regime outlets IRIB and Defa Press posted a heavy cycle of imagery from Tehran's Prayer Ground, including foreign delegations from Russia, China, India, Malaysia, Myanmar, Serbia, Tanzania and the ECO paying respects to Khamenei and his granddaughter Zahra Mohammadi Golpayegani. Jerusalem Post and Iran International reported the funeral spans a week, with Iran International citing public anger over businesses and state employees allegedly forced to fund ceremonies.

threads.label: Diaspora protest calls around funeral
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Crown Prince Reza Pahlavi urging the Iranian diaspora to gather outside US embassies for a "Global Week of Action for a Free Iran" during the funeral week. A separate Jerusalem Post comment piece framed the diaspora response as a counter to the regime's unity messaging.

threads.label: IDF strikes in southern Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck around 10 Hezbollah infrastructure sites in Bint Jbeil, Beit Yahoun, Kounine and Baraashit, and hit a cell transporting weapons near the Security Zone, citing repeated ceasefire violations. The strikes followed a clash in Bint Jbeil in which a reservist from the 679th "Yiftah" Armored Brigade was severely wounded by a Hezbollah gunman.

threads.label: Iran oil talks and Hormuz arrangement
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Iran has begun talks with Japanese companies to resume oil exports under a temporary US sanctions waiver. Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf separately announced an Iran-Oman agreement on Strait of Hormuz traffic regulation based on Article V of the MoU with the US.

threads.label: October 7 Hamas commander killed
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet announced the killing in a northern Gaza strike of Muhammad Na'im Jandiya, identified as head of military security in Hamas's Shuja'iyya Battalion. He was named as the commander of a Nukhba cell that infiltrated Kibbutz Nahal Oz on October 7, 2023, abducted Cpt. Daniel Perez and held hostages Yotam Haim, Samer Al-Talalka and Alon Shamriz.

events.title_en: Spokesperson for Yemen's Armed Forces: If Saudi Arabia violates Yemen's airspace again we will respond comprehensively
events.summary_en: Spokesman for Yemen's Armed Forces Yahya Saree stated: This morning (Friday) at 05:20, several Saudi coalition fighter jets attempted to violate Yemen's airspace in an effort to prevent an Iranian civilian aircraft from landing at Sana'a International Airport; an aircraft carrying over 200 trapped, wounded and sick Yemeni citizens. This attempt was thwarted by interception of the Saudi fighters by Yemen's air defence, and after firing several air defence missiles, the fighters were forced to leave Yemen's airspace. We warn Saudi Arabia against repeating any violation of airspace or aggression

events.title: A reservist soldier was severely wounded in a clash with a Hezbollah gunman in southern Lebanon's Bint Jbeil yesterday afternoon, the military announces. He was taken to a hospital and his family was notified, the IDF adds. According to an IDF probe of the incident, at around 6 p.m. during operations of the 679th "Yiftah" Armored Brigade in Bint Jbeil, troops encountered a Hezbollah gunman who opened fire on them, injuring one soldier seriously. Immediately after, troops struck the building where the gunman had shot from using tank shelling, and the Israeli Air Force struck other targets in the area. IDF troops are continuing to scan the area for the gunman as of this morning.
